seo.title: Train an AI agent on Notion | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect Notion to Steps AI so your agent answers customers from your own Notion content on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website.

hero.title: Answer customers from what is already in Notion.
hero.body: If your help articles, product notes or internal guides live in Notion, connect them and your agent can answer customers from the same pages your team uses.
hero.reassurance: Your own content. Connected once. Used by any agent you choose.

lines.text: What is your return policy for sale items?
Sale items can be exchanged within 14 days. Refunds are not available on sale items.

useCases.title: What you can do with Notion connected.
useCases.intro: Keep your information where your team already maintains it, and let the agent answer from it.

items.title: Turn Notion pages into answers
items.body: Help articles and product notes become answers your agent gives on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website.

items.title: Edit once, update everywhere
items.body: Change a page in Notion and every agent that uses it works from the change.

items.title: Pick the pages that matter
items.body: Connect only the pages meant for customers, and leave internal notes out.

setup.title: Connect Notion in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Notion
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Notion. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Notion to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Choose what the agent can read
items.body: Pick the pages, files or tables to use. They become workspace resources, so any agent can use them and one edit updates every agent.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The agent answers from the content you choose. Keep it up to date and the answers stay up to date.
Storage and processing limits depend on your plan.

items.q: Does the agent use everything in my account?
items.a: No. You choose what to connect, and the agent uses only that.

items.q: Can several agents use the same content?
items.a: Yes. Connected content is a workspace resource, so you set it up once and any agent can use it.

items.q: What if a question is not covered?
items.a: The agent can say it does not know and pass the conversation to your team. Web search is optional and off unless you switch it on.

cta.title: See Steps AI work with Notion.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using Notion and your own information.
